business_problem: Nexa Resources, a global zinc mining leader, faced challenges with legacy data systems, siloed operations and limited scalability, hindering innovation and decision-making.
solution_summary: Nexa Resources, a global zinc mining leader, faced challenges with legacy data systems, siloed operations and limited scalability, hindering innovation and decision-making. Databricks transformed Nexa’s infrastructure, enabling real-time insights, predictive models and AI-driven automation. This improved zinc filtration, reduced waste in material extraction and empowered teams to optimize equipment usage and workflows. Databricks has paved the way for smarter, AI-powered mining operations and sustainable growth. Nexa Resources is a global leader in the mining industry, specializing in the extraction and processing of non-ferrous metals, such as zinc and copper.
business_outcome: Nexa Resources achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 90% Reduction in development time; 9x Improvement in processing efficiency for IT supplier contract analysis; $370,000 Annual savings from predictive models for zinc filtration and cadmium removal.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Provides access control, governance, and lineage across Nexa Resources's shared data products and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores Nexa Resources's curated datasets for analytics, machine learning, and operational use cases.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, interactive analysis, and governed SQL workloads for business users at Nexa Resources.

solution_components.name: Agent Bricks
solution_components.role: Supports agentic or GenAI applications that Nexa Resources uses to automate or accelerate work.

data_flow: IoT telemetry and operational data lands in Databricks and is transformed into curated datasets stored in Delta Lake under Unity Catalog governance before being served through Databricks SQL
